_comment: Declarations in this repo that shadow a webindex export, with why they have not been adopted. A ratchet: entries may leave, never arrive. Anything not listed fails verify-engine-usage, so the next fork is an argued decision rather than a quiet copy. An entry that no longer matches anything also fails, so the list cannot rot.

forks.src/research/cache.ts:cacheDir: this cache is RICHER than the engine's (ETag revalidation, stats, clean). Adopting today would be a regression; the engine's cache has to grow first.
forks.src/research/fetch.ts:HttpResult: fetch stack genuinely diverges from the engine's — conditional GET / streaming caps / consent stripping. Reconciling it is a behaviour decision, not a dedup.
